data.name: Blitz Freak
data.detailed_description:
Captivate audiences as you soar through the air and knock out opponents in Blitz Freak.

Blitz Freak is an online 3on3 VR game optimized for e-Sports.
The rule is simple. Take control of the central area before your opponents!


-Master the Magnetic Arm
Use the Magnetic Arm in both hands to levitate and shoot objects at opponents. The heavier the object, the more damage it will deal. Flinging and detonating bombs will cause even more devastating damage. If you see a glowing yellow orb, pick it up to unleash your inner power!

-Soar to victory
In Blitz Freak, players don’t run to their destination, they fly!
Grapple on to buildings and rocket through the air to get to the central area before the others. The locomotion in Blitz Freak allows fast-paced movement, without the motion sickness.

-Battle friends online
With an online matching system, you can battle friends far away, or team up with them to fight other teams. You can also choose to team up or battle with complete strangers.

-Fascinate your audience
Your gameplay will be in first person, but the audience will be watching the match in third person. Cameras located throughout the stage will be following the most stunning player in the match. Amaze your audience!

reviews.review:
A fairly bland VR MOBA title focused on E-Sports but lacking any population.

https://youtu.be/R8NgQx2ddLE

While I enjoyed the idea of the spectator cam and I liked the layout provided the actual camera angles were pretty atrocious. As an e-sports focused title it just wasn't entertaining to watch.

Gameplay was also fairly lackluster. Perhaps this is due to the fact that I was only playing bots but there seemed to be little to no strategy, skill or thought. This likely contributes to the next point.

There's no population for the game. Logging in on a Monday night around 10pm EST and finding 0 games going is not going to keep players engaged in the game and that's going to continue to spiral until the game dies. If you can find a Discord server or some other community that you can setup games then this might mitigate the population issue somewhat but I really don't like the idea of having to go outside the game to find a team. It's one of the reasons Destiny doesn't grab me after the main story.

There's very little here to redeem the game and unfortunately this isn't going to be a game I can recommend.
